lines.en: label day295parttwo:
scene nightskysepia
I notice a distinct lack of color on my walk home.
lines.zh: 在回家的路上，我注意到周遭明显缺少颜色。

lines.en: I don’t typically leave[school] this late, nor do I remember how exactly the time managed to go by as quickly as it did.
lines.zh: 我平时不会这么晚才离开[school]，也不记得时间究竟是怎么过得这么快的。

lines.en: And yet, here I walk under dimly lit streetlights emitting a soft buzzing noise signalling that the end of their days approaches.
lines.zh: 然而此刻，我正走在昏暗的路灯下，听着它们发出的轻微嗡鸣——那是在宣告它们的末日将至。

lines.en: It reminds me of a noise I’ve heard recently, but can’t remember where or when.
lines.zh: 这让我联想到最近听到过的某种声音，却想不起是在哪里、在什么时候。

lines.en: I don’t look down as I walk.
lines.zh: 走路时我没有低头。

lines.en: I keep my eyes focused on the sky.
lines.zh: 我的目光始终锁定在天空上。

lines.en: It’s unsafe, sure. But I’ve walked this path time and time again and have yet to truly get lost.
lines.zh: 这当然不安全。但这条路我走过一遍又一遍，至今还没有真正迷过路。

lines.en: Or at least “lost” by the common definition of the word and not some more artistic way of describing it.
lines.zh: 至少，不是这个词通常意义上的“迷路”，不是某种更艺术化的说法。

lines.en: Actually, since we’re on the topic of art, there’s something I’d like you to look at.
lines.zh: 话说回来，既然都谈到艺术了，有样东西我想请你看看。

lines.en: scene redstring
Before you lies a line.
lines.zh: 在你面前躺着一条线。

lines.en: And if you align that line alongside lines of lies you tell yourself so you can sleep at night-
lines.zh: 而如果你把这条线，与你为了夜里能睡得着而对自己撒下的那些层层谎言排在一起——

lines.en: You have something red.
lines.zh: 你就会得到某种红色的东西。

lines.en: And red is an evil color.
lines.zh: 而红色是一种邪恶的颜色。

lines.en: Or so many would like you to think.
lines.zh: 至少很多人希望你这么想。

lines.en: But I think red can be beautiful under the right circumstances.
lines.zh: 但我觉得，在合适的情形下，红色也可以很美。

lines.en: A gift carefully wrapped underneath a Christmas tree.
lines.zh: 圣诞树下精心包装好的礼物。

lines.en: A fledgling cardinal taking flight for the first time.
lines.zh: 初次展翅高飞的雏红雀。

lines.en: The color of a heart.
lines.zh: 心脏的颜色。

lines.en: How can red be a bad color when things like all of these bring smiles to our faces?
lines.zh: 既然这些东西都能让我们露出笑容，红色又怎么会是坏颜色呢？

lines.en: Tug the line.
lines.zh: 拉动这条线。

lines.en: Tug the line and cross it.
lines.zh: 拉动这条线，然后跨过去。

lines.en: Tie it around all of the things you love and pull them along, dragging them across rough terrain until their skin (If applicable) begins to wear away.
lines.zh: 把它系在你所爱的一切上面，拖着它们走，拽着它们穿过崎岖的地面，直到它们的表皮（如果有的话）开始磨损。

lines.en: scene redstring2
I feel arms warp wrap* around me, the same way I’ve felt them countless times in the past.
lines.zh: 我感到有手臂环抱住我，就像过去无数次感受过的那样。

lines.en: My sinuses have become mostly clogged from the temperature of both the air and the snow dancing around me as I try to reopen my already opened eyes.
lines.zh: 空气的温度，加上在我身边飞舞的雪，把我的鼻窦堵得七七八八，而我还在试着重新睁开那双本来就睁着的眼睛。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
I see a sky, but it isn’t the right one.
lines.zh: 我看见了一片天空，但那不是正确的那片。

lines.en: It’s not the sky I saw just moments ago.
lines.zh: 那不是我片刻之前看见的天空。

lines.en: And it forces me into a state of worry that I have somehow gotten lost in a more literal sense than I’d been alluding to before.
lines.zh: 这让我陷入担忧——我大概是迷路了，而且比我之前暗指的那种迷路要字面意义得多。

lines.en: Why does everything have to hurt so much?
lines.zh: 为什么一切都非得这么疼呢？

lines.en: scene yasuwhite1
: Oh, how pitiful it is to lose yourself once again.
lines.zh: : 噢，再一次迷失自我，是多么可怜啊。

lines.en: : To find yourself trapped in a state of being that you can not influence and yet, somehow or another, pray to move your own limbs.
lines.zh: : 发现自己被困在一种你无法影响的存有状态里，却又祈祷着能以某种方式挪动自己的四肢。

lines.en: : To think your own thoughts.
lines.zh: : 思考自己的思绪。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite2
: Oh, how pitiful you are to find yourself lost.
lines.zh: : 噢，你迷失了自我，多么可怜啊。

lines.en: : To wander so aimlessly through the dark in search of...what?
lines.zh: : 在黑暗中漫无目的地游荡，寻找着……什么？

lines.en: : Salvation?
lines.zh: : 救赎？

lines.en: : Is that why you are here?
lines.zh: : 这就是你在这里的原因吗？

lines.en: : Has the time finally come for you to BREATHE?!
lines.zh: : 你终于到了可以 BREATHE 的时候了吗？！

lines.en: scene yasuwhite3
: Why does everything have to hurt so much, you ask?
lines.zh: : 为什么一切都非得这么疼呢，你问？

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it be wonderful if the answer was something like, “So we can feel alive?”
lines.zh: : 如果答案是类似“好让我们能感觉到自己活着”这样的话，那该有多美妙啊。

lines.en: : Oh, how glorious that would be.
lines.zh: : 噢，那该有多么荣耀。

lines.en: scene sky
scene noonsky
scene wintersky
scene nightsky
scene clearnightsky
scene yasuwhite4
I happen upon a girl in a white dress, standing still under the only living streetlight I can see.
lines.zh: 我偶然遇见一个穿着白裙的女孩，一动不动地站在我唯一能看见的那盏还亮着的路灯下。

lines.en: She shouldn’t be out this late.
lines.zh: 她不该这么晚还待在外面。

lines.en: Bad things tend to happen to girls who stay out this late. Especially ones as cute as her.
lines.zh: 这么晚还待在外面的女孩，往往会遇到不好的事。尤其是像她这么可爱的。

lines.en: Thoughts happen.
lines.zh: 一些念头冒了出来。

lines.en: You don’t want to hear about them.
lines.zh: 你不会想听的。

lines.en: : I’ve come out of hiding, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我从藏身之处出来了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Have we met somewhere before?
lines.zh: : 我们之前在哪里见过吗？

lines.en: : Have you forgotten me already? How sad.
lines.zh: : 你已经把我忘了吗？真让人难过。

lines.en: : I may have interrupted a private conversation you were having with a girl around my age several months ago.
lines.zh: : 几个月前，我也许打断过你和一位与我年纪相仿的女孩之间的私人谈话。

lines.en: : She was wearing a dress not much different from mine at the time. A dress I can no longer wear.
lines.zh: : 她当时穿着的裙子，和我这条没多大区别。一条我已经再也穿不了的裙子。

lines.en: The girl remains remarkably still, letting snow fall on top of her already snow-colored hair. Never blinking, even once.
lines.zh: 女孩保持着惊人的静止，任由雪花落在她本就雪白的头发上。一次都没有眨过眼。

lines.en: I think for a moment about whether or not those with blue eyes see everything in a slightly bluer tint and then, in a matter of seconds, wind up slipping toward the idea of the color red once again.
lines.zh: 我思索了片刻，想知道蓝眼睛的人是不是看什么都带一点更蓝的色调，然后，不过几秒钟的工夫，又滑回了关于红色的念头里。

lines.en: : Do you need me to remind you?
lines.zh: : 需要我提醒你吗？

lines.en: : What, can you teleport us back in time or something?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你还能把我们传送回过去什么的？

lines.en: : Let me close my eyes and try.
lines.zh: : 让我闭上眼睛试试。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite5
The girl actually closes her eyes and I think to myself that she must be messing with me.
lines.zh: 女孩真的闭上了眼睛，我心里想，她肯定是在耍我。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite4
: I’m sorry, but it doesn’t appear that I have that power.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我似乎并不具备那种力量。

lines.en: Yup. Definitely messing with me.
lines.zh: 嗯。绝对是在耍我。

lines.en: : Forget that. What are you doing out here just...standing under a streetlight?
lines.zh: : 算了。你这么晚在外面……就只是站在路灯底下干什么？

lines.en: : It’s the middle of the night and it’s freezing cold.
lines.zh: : 现在是半夜，而且冷得要死。

lines.en: : Are you worried about me?
lines.zh: : 你在担心我吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly. It’s just weird.
lines.zh: : 算不上。只是很奇怪。

lines.en: : Can you come closer? I would like to continue speaking with you, but my voice does not carry very well.
lines.zh: : 你能靠近一点吗？我想继续和你说话，但我的声音传不了那么远。

lines.en: Something tells me that I have nothing to gain from obliging, but...
lines.zh: 有某种感觉告诉我，顺从她不会给我带来任何好处，但是……

lines.en: There’s a morbid curiosity deep within me. A curiosity deeper than the thoughts of lines or lies, that moves my limbs without my consent.
lines.zh: 我内心深处有一种病态的好奇。一种比关于线与谎言的思绪更深的好奇，它在未经我允许的情况下挪动我的四肢。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite6
: Am I truly so forgettable? That’s no good at all.
lines.zh: : 我真的这么容易被忘掉吗？那样可一点也不好。

lines.en: : I remember you. You’re that crazy girl who showed up in the park when I was with Sana.
lines.zh: : 我记得你。你就是那个我和 Sana 在公园时冒出来的疯女孩。

lines.en: : Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: : That is such a pretty name.
lines.zh: : 多好听的名字啊。

lines.en: : Almost as pretty as her brother’s.
lines.zh: : 几乎和她哥哥的名字一样好听。

lines.en: : Do you...know his name?
lines.zh: : 你……知道他的名字？

lines.en: : Perhaps.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : How?
lines.zh: : 怎么会？

lines.en: : If I told you, would you run away?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你，你会逃跑吗？

lines.en: : There aren’t many things that can make me run away from a girl your size.
lines.zh: : 能让我从你这么点大的女孩面前逃跑的东西可不多。

lines.en: : But if you’re somehow communicating with my students’ dead relatives...yeah. I’d probably consider booking it.
lines.zh: : 但如果你是在以某种方式跟我学生死去的亲人沟通……那我大概会考虑撒腿就跑。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite7
: Hahahahahah!!! Hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : An unexpected response! How delightful it is to see you stand as still as a cross instead of running away!
lines.zh: : 出乎意料的反应！看到你像十字架一样站得笔直而没有逃走，是多么令人愉悦啊！

lines.en: : I take it you’re pretty used to people running away from you, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来你已经很习惯别人从你身边逃走了吧？

lines.en: scene yasuwhite8
: Why does everything have to hurt so much?
lines.zh: : 为什么一切都非得这么疼呢？

lines.en: : Oh. Okay. I guess we're moving on, then.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧。看来我们要往下走了。

lines.en: : Do you like...need something, or?
lines.zh: : 你是……需要什么，还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene yasuwhite9
: We all need something.
lines.zh: : 我们都需要某种东西。

lines.en: : Water. Food. Sex. Sleep.
lines.zh: : 水。食物。性。睡眠。

lines.en: : Without these pillars of existence and the endless pursuit of true bliss, we are but puddles of unused potential slowly dripping into sewers through grates on the ground.
lines.zh: : 若没有这些存在的支柱，以及对真正极乐的无尽追求，我们不过是一滩滩未被利用的潜能，顺着地上的格栅慢慢滴进下水道。

lines.en: : No offense, but you don’t really strike me as someone who revels in sex.
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，但你看上去不太像是会沉溺于性的人。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite10
: Of course not. I'm as pure as the snow.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。我如雪一般纯洁。

lines.en: : My chastity is proof of a love much greater than I could ever have.
lines.zh: : 我的贞洁，证明了一种远比我能拥有的爱更伟大的爱。

lines.en: : More pliable than flesh and more pure than water from the cleanest spring in all the land.
lines.zh: : 比肉体更易塑形，比这世上最清澈的泉水更纯净。

lines.en: : But I’m sure someone like you doesn’t need to hear that from a lowly messenger, do you?
lines.zh: : 不过像你这样的人，应该不需要从我这个卑微的信使口中听到这些吧？

lines.en: : I have no idea what that is supposed to-
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道那应该是在——

lines.en: scene yasuwhite11
: You know exactly what that is supposed to mean.
lines.zh: : 你完全清楚那是什么意思。

lines.en: : You can hear things too. You can see things.
lines.zh: : 你也听得到那些东西。你也看得到。

lines.en: : I can see that you see things. And I am a seer, so what I see is real.
lines.zh: : 我看得出你看得到那些东西。而我是先知，所以我看到的就是真实的。

lines.en: : You can only feign ignorance for so long.
lines.zh: : 你只能装傻，装得了一时，装不了一世。

lines.en: : I’m not feigning anything, I really haven’t-
lines.zh: : 我没有在装什么，我是真的没有——

lines.en: scene yasuwhite6
: Then you must be either truly callous or truly dense. And I pray that it’s the latter for both of our sakes.
lines.zh: : 那你要么是真正冷漠，要么是真正迟钝。为了我们两个人好，我祈祷是后者。

lines.en: This girl is insane.
lines.zh: 这女孩疯了。

lines.en: : I really don’t care about whatever you pray for, but you should probably try and find a place to stay for the night.
lines.zh: : 你祈祷什么我一点都不在乎，但你可能该去找个过夜的地方了。

lines.en: : And if I have nowhere to go, will you escort me to your stable like a lost, little lamb?
lines.zh: : 那如果我没有地方可去，你会像领走一只迷途的小羊羔那样，把我护送进你的羊圈吗？

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t have a stable, but you can crash at my place if you want.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我没有羊圈，不过你愿意的话可以去我家凑合一晚。

lines.en: : I’m locking my door, though. You’re cute, but not cute enough for me to risk my life over.
lines.zh: : 不过我会锁门的。你是挺可爱，但还没可爱到让我愿意拿命去冒险。

lines.en: : I have no reason to hurt you. Nor anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我没有理由伤害你。也没有理由伤害任何人。

lines.en: : I exist solely to communicate. To spread the word of GOD god GoD God and to bathe in his light.
lines.zh: : 我的存在只为传达。传播 GOD god GoD God 的话语，并沐浴在他的光中。

lines.en: : Light that you have the pleasure to bathe in whenever you want, and yet you stray further into the dark and further away from the answer to everything.
lines.zh: : 你随时都能沐浴在那光里，这是你的荣幸，可你却越走越深地陷入黑暗，离一切的答案越来越远。

lines.en: : You are special.
lines.zh: : 你是特别的。

lines.en: : Much more special than someone like me.
lines.zh: : 远比像我这样的人要特别。

lines.en: : That's probably not something you should be saying to unfamiliar men in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 这种话大概不该在半夜对一个陌生男人说吧。

lines.en: : Nothing bad will ever happen to me, for I am blessed.
lines.zh: : 任何坏事都不会发生在我身上，因为我蒙受恩典。

lines.en: : And, even if something bad did happen, it would be for a reason. It would be for something larger.
lines.zh: : 而且，即便真有坏事发生，那也是有缘由的。是为了某个更宏大的东西。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite12
: Why do you continue to wait?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么还要继续等？！

lines.en: : Why do you make me him wait?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要让他等？！

lines.en: : Why is there so much waiting?! Every hand on every clock is moving! They tick! They tock!
lines.zh: : 为什么要有这么多的等待？！每一只钟上的每一根指针都在动！它们滴！它们答！

lines.en: : Time marches on and yet you remain still!
lines.zh: : 时间滚滚向前，而你却停滞不动！

lines.en: : Still still still still still!
lines.zh: : 不动不动不动不动不动！

lines.en: scene yasuwhite8
: Why does everything have to hurt so much?
lines.zh: : 为什么一切都非得这么疼呢？

lines.en: : You know, maybe we should get you back to my...stable. You’re clearly delusional from the cold and-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许我们该把你带回我的……羊圈。你显然是冻得神志不清了，而且——

lines.en: scene yasuwhite10
: Stables are for animals, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 羊圈是给牲畜住的，Sensei。

lines.en: : I am not the little lamb you think I am.
lines.zh: : 我不是你以为的那只小羊羔。

lines.en: : If anything, you are the lamb. And I am the shepherd, here to guide you to where you need to be.
lines.zh: : 如果说有什么区别的话，你才是那只羊羔。而我，是来指引你去往你该去之处的牧羊人。

lines.en: : If only you were willing to open your heart wide enough to be accepted there.
lines.zh: : 只要你愿意把心敞开到足够大，大到能被接纳进去。

lines.en: : Sorry, opening my heart isn’t really a strong suit of mine.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，敞开心扉真不是我的强项。

lines.en: : I prefer to keep everything locked away. And, honestly, I’d prefer it if you would do the same. You’re kind of freaking me out.
lines.zh: : 我更愿意把一切都锁起来。而且说实话，我也希望你能把你的锁起来。你有点把我吓到了。

lines.en: : The things I do with my body and mind are not of my own choice. I am but a vessel for the one so commonly mislabeled.
lines.zh: : 我用身体和心智做的事，都不是出于我自己的选择。我不过是那位常被误称之者的器皿。

lines.en: : A god not as old as the others, but dying just the same.
lines.zh: : 一位没有其他神明那么古老，却同样正在死去的神。

lines.en: : If you were to find a dying animal on the side of the road ...a lamb, convulsing after being hit by a car. Coughing up blood...
lines.zh: : 如果你在路边发现一只垂死的动物……一只被车撞后正在抽搐的小羊羔。咳着血……

lines.en: : Would you ignore it? Or would you attempt to save it?
lines.zh: : 你会无视它？还是会试图救它？

lines.en: : I’d probably convince myself I never saw it and just keep walking.
lines.zh: : 我大概会说服自己从没看见过，然后继续走。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite13
: Does that fulfill you?
lines.zh: : 那样让你满足吗？

lines.en: : Does it not haunt you when you crawl into bed at night?
lines.zh: : 夜里爬上床的时候，它难道不会缠着你吗？

lines.en: : It’s all real. Everything you see is real. Everything you feel is real. If it exists to you, it is real.
lines.zh: : 一切都是真的。你看到的一切都是真的。你感受到的一切都是真的。只要它对你而言存在，它就是真的。

lines.en: : What else would it mean to be real in the first place?
lines.zh: : 否则，“真实”从一开始又是什么意思呢？

lines.en: : I get that you’re a missionary or whatever, but comparing your god to a dying animal isn’t really all that convincing if you’re trying to convert me.
lines.zh: : 我知道你是个传教士还是什么的，但如果你想让我皈依，把你的神比作一只垂死的动物可不太有说服力。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite14
: You can not convert someone who doesn’t believe in anything.
lines.zh: : 你无法让一个什么都不信的人皈依。

lines.en: : You can only wait patiently and explain.
lines.zh: : 你只能耐心等待，并加以解释。

lines.en: : Which is why my “dying animal” is the answer to all things.
lines.zh: : 正因如此，我的“垂死的动物”才是一切的答案。

lines.en: : It is a dying animal that will lay there, convulsing and coughing up blood until someone reaches out their hand.
lines.zh: : 那是一只垂死的动物，会躺在那里抽搐、咳血，直到有人伸出援手。

lines.en: : Eternally writhing in pain for the sake of giving others a chance to be saved.
lines.zh: : 为了给别人一个被拯救的机会，而永远在痛苦中翻滚。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite9
: Which is precisely why everything needs to hurt so much.
lines.zh: : 这恰恰就是为什么一切都必须要这么疼。

lines.en: : I hurt because you hurt. You hurt because I hurt. He hurts because all of us hurt.
lines.zh: : 我疼，是因为你疼。你疼，是因为我疼。他疼，是因为我们所有人都疼。

lines.en: : We are all but dying animals. So when we see someone else having a particularly hard time, we must offer our assistance.
lines.zh: : 我们都不过是垂死的动物。所以当我们看到别人格外难熬时，就必须伸出援手。

lines.en: scene yasuwhite6
: I reach out my hand to you. Take it if you will. For I may not be able to show you the light myself, but I can take you somewhere brighter.
lines.zh: : 我向你伸出手。你愿意的话，就握住它。因为也许我无法亲自让你看见光，但我能带你去某个更明亮的地方。

lines.en: : I know where the sanctuary is. And I can show you the moment you decide to open yourself up to something greater.
lines.zh: : 我知道圣所在哪里。在你决定向某种更宏大的东西敞开心扉的那一刻，我就能指给你看。

lines.en: : Come with me.
lines.zh: : 跟我来。

lines.en: : I can show you such beautiful things.
lines.zh: : 我能让你看见无比美丽的东西。

lines.en: : I ask for nothing in return. Nor could I if I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 我不求任何回报。就算我想，也做不到。

lines.en: : I am only a vessel.
lines.zh: : 我只是一个器皿。

lines.en: The wind begins to pick up and rapidly blow the strange girl’s hair around.
lines.zh: 风开始变大，把这个奇怪女孩的头发吹得四散飞舞。

lines.en: It whips her in the face and turns her already rosy cheeks an even darker shade of red.
lines.zh: 发丝抽打在她的脸上，把她本就粉红的脸颊又添了一层更深的红。

lines.en: But she does not attempt to stop the pain that comes with her own body being turned into a weapon.
lines.zh: 但她没有试图阻止这份疼痛——那是她自己的身体被当成武器所带来的疼痛。

lines.en: She just grips her necklace and looks deep into my eyes.
lines.zh: 她只是攥紧自己的项链，深深望进我的眼睛。

lines.en: Deeper than I would ever want anyone to.
lines.zh: 深到我不希望任何人望进来的程度。

lines.en: : What is your name?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么名字？

lines.en: : My name?
lines.zh: : 我的名字？

lines.en: : Yes. I’m not asking to be friends or anything, but it would probably be good to know in the event that we run into each other again.
lines.zh: : 对。我不是要跟你交朋友什么的，不过万一我们以后再碰上，知道名字大概会好办些。

lines.en: : We will run into each other many more times.
lines.zh: : 我们还会碰上很多次的。

lines.en: : But I do not have a name. Nor do I need one.
lines.zh: : 但我没有名字。我也不需要名字。

lines.en: : There is no sense in having a name when I exist not for myself but-
lines.zh: : 我并非为自己而存在，那么有名字就没有意义，我只为——

lines.en: : For “the one so commonly mislabeled.” Right.
lines.zh: : 为“那位常被误称之者”。我知道。

lines.en: : Whatever. That’s fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 随你吧。我觉得也行。

lines.en: : I really don’t want to spend the entire night listening to you ramble on about that, though, so I’m probably going to head out now.
lines.zh: : 不过我可不想整晚都听你念叨这些，所以我现在大概要走了。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re okay out here? You don’t need a place to stay or anything?
lines.zh: : 你确定你一个人在这儿没事？不需要地方住什么的？

lines.en: : I thank you for the offer, but I am fine as I am.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的好意，但我这样就好。

lines.en: : I have somewhere I need to be anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我还有个地方要去。

lines.en: : Suit yourself, then.
lines.zh: : 那随你吧。

lines.en: : Any creepy parting words for me before I go?
lines.zh: : 我走之前，有什么诡异的临别赠言要给我吗？

lines.en: scene yasuwhite15
: Yes.
: You are surrounded by whispers.
lines.zh: : 你被低语包围着。

lines.en: : Someone misses you very much.
lines.zh: : 有人非常想念你。

lines.en: : Tick tock.
lines.zh: : 滴答，滴答。
